provenance.note: Filtered by place rather than by name, so the table knows more than the corpus does. Piru, Gorman and Lebec are in Ventura and Kern counties and are included on purpose: the Camulos, Ridge Route and Fort Tejon material is about places the county line runs through. Financial columns are dropped; this is an identity table. An organization absent from it may simply never have been exempt, or may have dissolved before the BMF began.
